atoms.name: ACID properties
atoms.one_line: Atomicity, consistency, isolation, durability and who enforces each.

atoms.name: Transaction states
atoms.one_line: Active, partially committed, committed, failed, aborted.

atoms.name: Conflicts and anomalies
atoms.one_line: Same item, different transactions, one write; dirty read, lost update.

atoms.name: Precedence graph
atoms.one_line: Edges from conflicts; acyclic means conflict serializable.

atoms.name: Equivalent serial orders and counting
atoms.one_line: $n!$, topological sorts, counting conflict serializable interleavings.

atoms.name: View serializability
atoms.one_line: Initial reads, reads-from, final writes; blind writes.

atoms.name: Recoverability
atoms.one_line: Recoverable, cascadeless, strict; commit order versus reads-from.

atoms.name: Log-based recovery
atoms.one_line: Undo and redo lists, checkpoints, idempotence.

patterns.name: Conflict serializability of a given schedule
